description.zh:
Critical级别阈值比较符。取值：

- GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold：大于等于。
- GreaterThanThreshold：大于。
- LessThanOrEqualToThreshold：小于等于。
- LessThanThreshold：小于。
- NotEqualToThreshold：不等于。
- EqualToThreshold：等于。
- GreaterThanYesterday：同比昨天时间上涨。
- LessThanYesterday：同比昨天时间下降。
- GreaterThanLastWeek：同比上周同一时间上涨。
- LessThanLastWeek：同比上周同一时间下降。
- GreaterThanLastPeriod：环比上周期上涨。
- LessThanLastPeriod：环比上周期下降。

> 报警级别Critical（严重）、Warn（警告）或Info（信息）至少设置一个，且该报警级别中的参数Statistics、ComparisonOperator、Threshold和Times必须同时设置。
description.en:
The comparison operator for the Critical level. Valid values:

- GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold: greater than or equal to the threshold.
- GreaterThanThreshold: greater than the threshold.
- LessThanOrEqualToThreshold: less than or equal to the threshold.
- LessThanThreshold: less than the threshold.
- NotEqualToThreshold: not equal to the threshold.
- EqualToThreshold: equal to the threshold.
- GreaterThanYesterday: greater than the value at the same time yesterday.
- LessThanYesterday: less than the value at the same time yesterday.
- GreaterThanLastWeek: greater than the value at the same time last week.
- LessThanLastWeek: less than the value at the same time last week.
- GreaterThanLastPeriod: greater than the value in the last period.
- LessThanLastPeriod: less than the value in the last period.

> At least one of the alert levels Critical, Warn, or Info must be set. The parameters Statistics, ComparisonOperator, Threshold, and Times must be set together for the specified alert level.

description.zh:

title.zh: 为指定资源的指定监控项设置一条阈值报警规则
title.en: Set a threshold alert rule for a specified metric of a specified resource

descriptions.zh:
本文将提供一个示例，为云服务器ECS `acs_ecs_dashboard`的实例`i-uf6j91r34rnwawoo****`中的监控项`cpu_total`设置阈值报警规则。该报警规则的报警联系组为`ECS_Group`、报警规则名称为`test123`、报警规则ID为`a151cd6023eacee2f0978e03863cc1697c89508****`、Critical级别的统计方法为`Average`、Critical级别的比较符为`GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold`、Critical级别的阈值为`90`和Critical级别的报警重试次数为`3`。
> 2024-08-15 增加Statistics校验，统计值只能填对应指标的Statistics。关于如何获取该参数的取值，请参见[云产品监控项](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/cms/support/appendix-1-metrics)。
descriptions.en:
This topic provides an example on how to set a threshold alert rule for the `cpu_total` metric of the Elastic Computing Service (ECS) instance `i-uf6j91r34rnwawoo****` in the `acs_ecs_dashboard` namespace. The alert contact group is `ECS_Group`, the alert rule name is `test123`, the alert rule ID is `a151cd6023eacee2f0978e03863cc1697c89508****`, the statistical method for the Critical level is `Average`, the comparison operator for the Critical level is `GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold`, the threshold for the Critical level is `90`, and the retry count for the Critical level is `3`.
> As of August 15, 2024, Statistics validation is increased. The statistical value must match the Statistics of the corresponding metric. For more information about how to obtain the value of this parameter, see [Alibaba Cloud service monitoring metrics](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/cms/support/appendix-1-metrics).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cms put-resource-metric-rule --rule-id a151cd6023eacee2f0978e03863cc1697c895080000 --rule-name test123 --namespace acs_ecs_dashboard --metric-name cpu_total --resources instanceId_:_i-uf6j91r34rnwawoo0000 --contact-groups ECS_Group --webhook https://alert.aliyun.com.com:8080/callback --effective-interval 00:00-23:59 --no-effective-interval 00:00-06:00 --silence-time 86400 --period 60 --interval 60 --email-subject ECS_instance_alert --escalations-critical-statistics Average --escalations-critical-comparison-operator GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold --escalations-critical-threshold 90 --escalations-critical-times 3 --escalations-warn-statistics Average --escalations-warn-comparison-operator GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold --escalations-warn-threshold 90 --escalations-warn-times 3 --escalations-info-statistics Average --escalations-info-comparison-operator GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold --escalations-info-threshold 90 --escalations-info-times 3 --no-data-policy KEEP_LAST_STATE --composite-expression '{"Times":3,"ExpressionRaw":"Average_instanceId_==_i-io8kfvcpp7x50000_0_80:_50","ExpressionListJoin":"example-string","Level":"CRITICAL","ExpressionList":[{"MetricName":"cpu_total","ComparisonOperator":"GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold","Period":60,"Statistics":"Maximum","Threshold":"90"}]}' --labels Value=ECS Key=tagKey1 --prometheus '{"Annotations":[{"Value":"labels.instance_CPU_usage_above_10%_current_value:_humanizePercentage_value","Key":"summary"}],"PromQL":"cpuUsage_instanceId=_xxxx_1m_90","Times":3,"Level":"CRITICAL"}' --send-ok true --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cms PutResourceMetricRule --region cn-hangzhou --NoEffectiveInterval '00:00-06:00' --Escalations.Critical.ComparisonOperator GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold --Escalations.Info.ComparisonOperator GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold --RuleId a151cd6023eacee2f0978e03863cc1697c895080000 --Escalations.Warn.Times 3 --Labels.1.Key tagKey1 --Prometheus '{"Annotations":[{"Value":"labels.instance_CPU_usage_above_10%_current_value:_humanizePercentage_value","Key":"summary"}],"PromQL":"cpuUsage_instanceId=_xxxx_1m_90","Times":3,"Level":"CRITICAL"}' --Escalations.Info.Threshold 90 --MetricName cpu_total --Escalations.Warn.Statistics Average --Escalations.Warn.ComparisonOperator GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold --EmailSubject ECS_instance_alert --CompositeExpression '{"Times":3,"ExpressionRaw":"Average_instanceId_==_i-io8kfvcpp7x50000_0_80:_50","ExpressionListJoin":"example-string","Level":"CRITICAL","ExpressionList":[{"MetricName":"cpu_total","ComparisonOperator":"GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold","Period":60,"Statistics":"Maximum","Threshold":"90"}]}' --RuleName test123 --ContactGroups ECS_Group --SilenceTime 86400 --Escalations.Info.Times 3 --SendOK true --Labels.1.Value ECS --Escalations.Info.Statistics Average --Period 60 --EffectiveInterval '00:00-23:59' --NoDataPolicy KEEP_LAST_STATE --Namespace acs_ecs_dashboard --Escalations.Critical.Statistics Average --Escalations.Warn.Threshold 90 --Escalations.Critical.Times 3 --Webhook 'https://alert.aliyun.com.com:8080/callback' --Resources 'instanceId_:_i-uf6j91r34rnwawoo0000' --Escalations.Critical.Threshold 90 --Interval 60
